notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
description:
Activate Thunderclap Drake by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing it.
Cast Here Comes a New Hero! by paying {5}{U}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Thunderclap Drake triggers, copying Here Comes a New Hero! at least twice, with all copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Here Comes a New Hero! spells, creating at least three copies of Biovisionary and causing a player to draw nine cards.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.
